purpose: Evaluate current official documentation for managed protected-runtime candidates against Mythical's PR-001 boundary without selecting a provider, creating an account, configuring access, asserting price, or authorizing deployment.

platformCapabilityRequirements.name: Bounded ephemeral job execution
platformCapabilityRequirements.requirement: One task, concurrency one, timeout 120 seconds, retry zero, and ephemeral execution can be enforced.

platformCapabilityRequirements.name: Separate workload identities
platformCapabilityRequirements.requirement: Orchestrator, assurance, scheduler, and history writer can use distinct least-privilege non-human identities.

platformCapabilityRequirements.name: Separated scheduling
platformCapabilityRequirements.requirement: A scheduler identity can invoke only the approved content-addressed entry point and remain disabled by default.

platformCapabilityRequirements.name: Deny-by-default egress
platformCapabilityRequirements.requirement: Outbound traffic can be denied by default and any later allowlist is explicit, narrow, and tested.

platformCapabilityRequirements.name: Read-only source and ephemeral scratch
platformCapabilityRequirements.requirement: Source is immutable to the job and temporary output is destroyed after bounded evaluation.

platformCapabilityRequirements.name: Tamper-resistant minimal history
platformCapabilityRequirements.requirement: Content-addressed compact records can be retained without overwrite and with separate writer/readers.

platformCapabilityRequirements.name: Encrypted minimized observability
platformCapabilityRequirements.requirement: Logs and metrics are encrypted, access-controlled, retention-bounded, and exclude raw or sensitive payloads.

platformCapabilityRequirements.name: Authenticated exception route
platformCapabilityRequirements.requirement: High/critical exception delivery can authenticate the route and recipient, deduplicate, and fail visibly.

platformCapabilityRequirements.name: Secret lifecycle
platformCapabilityRequirements.requirement: Credential references use a managed secret boundary with scoped retrieval, rotation, revocation, and audit.

platformCapabilityRequirements.name: Metering and hard resource stop
platformCapabilityRequirements.requirement: Usage can be attributed and a tested technical stop prevents execution beyond approved zero-or-bounded limits.

platformCapabilityRequirements.name: Kill and revocation path
platformCapabilityRequirements.requirement: Operators can stop new work, terminate active work, revoke runtime identity, and preserve minimum evidence.

platformCapabilityRequirements.name: Recovery and replay resistance
platformCapabilityRequirements.requirement: History backup/restore, partial failure, stale configuration, clock drift, and replay can be tested.

sources.title: Execute Cloud Run jobs on a schedule
Direct VPC egress for Cloud Run

candidates.runtimeStack: Cloud Run Jobs plus Cloud Scheduler, user-managed service accounts, controlled VPC egress, and protected Cloud Storage
strengths: Job-native bounded execution with configurable timeout, retries, task count, and parallelism
Separate job and scheduler service identities are documented
VPC egress controls and retention-locked object storage provide a credible route to isolation and protected history
knownConstraints: Deny-all egress must be designed and tested rather than inferred from VPC attachment
Independent assurance, log minimization, alerts, secret rotation, spend hard stop, kill behavior, and recovery remain configuration evidence gaps
Region, data processing terms, security posture, exact pricing, account ownership, and exit path are unreviewed

candidates.runtimeStack: ECS standalone tasks on Fargate plus EventBridge Scheduler, task roles, S3 Object Lock, Secrets Manager, and AWS Budgets
strengths: Fargate tasks provide a distinct isolation boundary and task roles separate application permissions from execution permissions
WORM storage, managed secrets, and budget actions provide strong component options
knownConstraints: More components and IAM relationships increase configuration, review, recovery, and operator burden
Network deny, immutable source, log minimization, alert failure, active-run kill, and replay controls remain unverified
Region, data processing terms, security posture, exact pricing, account ownership, and exit path are unreviewed

candidates.runtimeStack: GitHub-hosted Actions runner with least-privilege permissions, concurrency control, OIDC, and protected environments
strengths: Existing repository context reduces bootstrap friction
OIDC can avoid stored long-lived cloud credentials
Concurrency and environment protection controls are documented
knownConstraints: Workflow definition, source, execution, and much of the evidence plane remain coupled to the same repository trust domain
Plan-dependent environment-review availability and administrator bypass behavior require verification
It does not by itself establish independent AG-010 identity, tamper-resistant history, deny-all egress, resource hard stop, or recovery proof

nextDecision: Kevin may confirm whether PE-001 should receive the first bounded security, privacy, terms, regional, exact-cost, account-ownership, exit, and failure-test review; that response does not authorize an account, terms acceptance, provisioning, credentials, scheduling, storage, alerts, spend, or execution.
